_comment: Published mirror of src/lib/measure/bridges.ts BRIDGES (trust anchor). The engine uses the code definitions; regenerate with `npx tsx scripts/gen-bridges.ts`.

power_to_energy.authoring: Installed capacity × hours per year × capacity factor = annual energy generated from the same resource.

fuel_to_energy.carrier_rule: lhv MUST be res:$R#lhv — the LHV of the same resource the fuel mass belongs to.
fuel_to_energy.authoring: Fuel mass × its heating value (LHV) = energy content; the LHV is taken from the resource registry.

energy_to_co2.carrier_rule: ef MUST be res:$R#ef — the same carrier R the energy belongs to (otherwise the kz-27 class of error).
energy_to_co2.authoring: Energy of resource R × the EF of THAT SAME R = CO₂. Taking another resource EF is a carrier error.

fuel_switch_abatement.carrier_rule: ef_old=res:$R_old#ef, ef_new=res:$R_new#ef; `from` is the energy of R_old. Two chains, each on its own resource.
fuel_switch_abatement.authoring: Abatement = energy of the displaced fuel × (displaced EF − new EF). Each EF belongs to its own resource.
